"hooks": unit text -> one line about the whole word, shown after the per-kanji lines (owner 2026-10-15: at most 12 words, true to the parts; a mnemonic that is not etymology starts with "think:"). "parts": a bare kanji -> breakdown for its line in every unit of "levels" whose kanji has no one-character unit earlier in the file (true takes the table breakdown / hook story); "unit:kanji" -> breakdown for that line only. Sources: KANJIDIC2/KRADFILE parts read by hand against the standard phono-semantic analysis; (sound x) marks the phonetic. Batch 1: levels A1, A2.
